posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked:
An on time State of GTG post! Unprecedented in 2019! Things are going very well as we gear up for the summer/fall convention and release season. We've also ironed out a number of internal processes that will really help us going forward. Here's some stuff we did:

  1. Funded and concluded the Kickstarter for the Sentinel Comics RPG!
  2. Seriously, we unlocked so many books! Wow!
  3. Created a production schedule for the next three years; that's right, we know roughly what we'll be working on every month through 2021.
  4. Commissioned writing for all of the unlocked SC:RPG books.
  5. Moved most of the core SC:RPG rulebook chapters into final editing.
  6. Met with the creators of Medium, a very fun party game we'll be publishing this year.
  7. Commissioned a ton of Jagged Earth art and began layout on the bulk of the expansion.
  8. Organized our warehouse and got caught up on freight orders for the first time since May.

Here is the status of all of our works in progress.

In Stock Since mid-January

  • Bottom of the 9th reprint
  • Spirit Island (7th printing)
  • Spirit Island: Branch & Claw reprint
  • SotM: Omnitron-IV reprint

Shipping to Backers

  • Nothing

In Transit; On a Boat

  • Villains of the Multiverse reprint
  • Spirit Island: Promo Spirit Pack 1 reprint

At Factory; Pre-Press Work

  • Legends of Sleepy Hollow
  • Homebrewers
  • Microbrewers

Current WIP Focus by GTG

  • Sentinel Comics: The Role Playing Game core rulebook (Christopher, Jenn, Critical Hits)
  • Prime War (Christopher, Chris Burton, Lore Forge)
  • Spirit Island: The Jagged Earth (Paul, Christopher, Jenn, Erik)
  • Sentinels of Freedom video game (Christopher, Adam, Underbite Studio)
  • The History of Sentinel Comics (Christopher, Adam)
  • Medium (Jenn, Chris Burton, Christopher)
  • Untitled Cheapass Games Project (Jenn, Chris Burton, James Ernest)
  • Milkman (Chris Kirkman, Chris Burton)
  • Fate of the Elder Gods: Agents of Arkham (Chris Kirkman)
  • Some other games (Chris Kirkman, Chris Burton)
  • A new and improved website (Jenn, Paul, Alex, Joel)

I'll see you next month!

posts.cooked: What about the Spirit Island errata pack? Is that coming back in stock with the Promo Pack 1 reprint?
posts.raw: What about the Spirit Island errata pack? Is that coming back in stock with the Promo Pack 1 reprint?

posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked:
@dpt

No, that will not be back in stock at the same time. We may have it available again in the summer, but we have already sold as many copies of the errata pack as we sold of editions of the game that require it, so some people definitely picked it up unnecessarilly.
